Name: Shops Expanded
Author: scarboy17
Description:
Hey everyone this mod expands Pierre's, Clints, Marnies, Robins, Willy's, The dwarfs, Adventure guild and krobus sewer stores with various new additions with more being added over time.

New update allows you to edit prices and availability through the new config file that will be automatically generated when you start the game. Recommended to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to edit values. Will need to exit and then reenter the store for prices to update. You can configure availability, prices and stock limits by adjusting their values or turning it off.

[u]How to install[/u]
[list]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi 4.0.0 or later[/url].
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher 2.0.0 or later[/url].
[*]Make sure that the game is on at least 1.6.
[*]Download the main file and extract into your mods folder﻿﻿.
[*]Optional but highly recommended [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to be able to edit prices and availability ingame.
[/list]
